notes:
Lead came via self-serve sign-up + onboarding form (Feb 11). CTO said: "we need to reduce token spend immediately — trials burning credits". Wants a lightweight POC and a token audit. Priority: cost predictability > custom routing for now.

Timeline (recent):
- 2026-02-11: self-serve signup, used free credit, submitted onboarding form (notes: heavy chat + docs embeddings).
- 2026-02-14: 30m intro call (Jordan Hayes + Taylor Chen) — demo of hosted API, quick primers on batching and caching. Fireflies id ff_20260214_8472.
- 2026-02-18: emailed token-usage CSV request (gt_20260218_1199) — customer provided export of 7 days of session logs.

- 2026-02-28: follow-up call to align on POC scope and success metrics.

Use-case & requirements (notes / fragments):
- Primary workload: support chat assistant + backend embeddings for contextual retrieval.
- Target latencies: chat 95th < 300ms preferred for UI snappiness.
- Throughput: initial 2k user messages/day, burst to 10k/day during launches.
- Cost sensitivity: high — runway limited, want to cut token spend 40-60% vs current trial rate.
- Model preference: open / efficient model variants (quantized where possible). Interested in Redwood catalog recommendations.
- Routing/fallback: simple: primary hosted model + lower-cost fallback during bursts. No complex multi-region routing yet.
- Security: SOC2 required for production; SSO via Okta; audit logs; retention controls (30–90d).

Technical asks raised by engineering (shorthand):
- Detailed guidance on batching windows vs latency tradeoffs (example configs).
- Prefix + KV cache advice for repeated turn/FAQ reuse. Can Redwood estimate token savings for given session traces?
- Prompt compression strategies and examples (role/system prompt minimization, templating).
- Request for a token-usage audit of their 7-day export and a short report with 3 quick wins.
- Small canary POC: 2-week hosted API usage with batching/caching enabled, measure cost delta.

Quotes & paraphrases: "Free credits are disappearing fast — we need quick wins to keep this viable." — Head of Engineering.

Next steps (CRM style):
- AE (Jordan) to send batching + token-audit checklist and example config by 2026-03-03.
- SE (Taylor) to prepare pre-check: run quick token audit on received CSV and return initial savings estimate (3 quick wins) by 2026-03-06.
- Schedule 45m POC scoping call wk of 2026-03-08 (Jordan + Taylor + Rainbarrel CTO + Eng lead).
